description: Simple log of accepted baselines and later evaluated replacements for the canonical models.
how_to_use: Keep the first entry as the starting baseline.
When a new model is assessed, append a new entry with a short description of the change and the new metrics.
Use artifacts/models/latest_main_model_metrics.json as the source for the latest candidate numbers.

protocol_note.rolling_cv: Rolling expanding-window CV is the research-time selection protocol. In the canonical main-model script the hyperparameters are already frozen, so the last pre-test season is only used to choose the epoch.
protocol_note.epoch_selection_season: 2425 is not part of Step 1 training. It is the holdout season used to choose the best epoch. After that, the final model is retrained on 1415-2425 and evaluated once on the untouched 2526 test season.

entries.description: Starting canonical baseline. Current production models before any new experiments are assessed.
